kb_searchEmpty: No results yet, type a query to search
kb_sizeLimitTip: Each file up to 64 MB, total up to 256 MB per upload
kb_previewTruncated: Large content, only the first part is previewed
kb_previewUnsupported: Inline preview is not available for this format (legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt, archives, etc.). Download to open it; re-save .doc/.xls/.ppt as the x format and re-upload to preview
kb_fileTooLarge: {name} exceeds the 64 MB per-file limit and was not added
kb_fileTooLargeCount: {n} files exceed the 64 MB per-file limit and were skipped
kb_totalTooLarge: Selected files exceed 256 MB in total, remove some or upload in batches
kb_uploadHelp: Supports PDF / DOCX / XLSX / PPTX / OFD / TXT / MD / CSV / HTML / JSON (legacy DOC/XLS/PPT are searchable by title only; scanned files without a text layer are flagged); duplicate content is skipped; full text is extracted and vector-embedded on upload for semantic search
kb_editHelp: Title/summary are indexed; saving re-embeds automatically
kb_dirEmpty: No directories yet, create one at top right
kb_sideTip: Drag directories to re-nest; drag a row's ⋮⋮ onto a directory to move documents; drop on "All Documents" to move back to root
kb_uploadHelp2: Archives zip/rar/7z/tar/gz are auto-extracted with inner structure as directories (nested archives supported); directory upload recreates the structure; title/summary apply to single file only; duplicates skipped; password-protected archives cannot be extracted
kb_embedNone: Select documents or a directory first
kb_dragHandle: Drag onto a directory to move
kb_visTip: Everyone = readable by all; Conditional = readable when read/write rules match; Private = only uploader and admins (plus write grantees)
kb_writeRulesTip: Write grantees also gain read access; uploader/creator and admins always have full access
kb_uploadVisTip: Applies to every new document in this batch (existing duplicates unaffected)
